email.description: The NORMALIZED e-mail — what was actually written, which can differ from what was typed. This is what the installer records in its marker.

workspaceId.description: The personal workspace born in the SAME transaction (RN-410), with the account as its `owner`. Without it the install would close with a login that works and a dashboard where "New project" has nowhere to create.

400.description: Malformed e-mail, or a password the DOMAIN policy refuses — the same code registration calls, never a second rule.

403.description: Service token missing or different from the shared one.

409.description: The installation already has a user. Nothing was created.
